moments.title: Glasgow Commonwealth Games Underway
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow are in full swing, featuring over 3,000 athletes from 74 nations competing across various sports until August 2nd.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games are lighting up the city with incredible sporting action all week. Who are you cheering for?

angles.name: Scottish Focus
angles.copy: Our very own Glasgow is at the heart of the Commonwealth Games! So much to see and do, from athletics to swimming. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Latitude Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: Latitude Festival concludes today in Henham Park, Suffolk, after four days of music, comedy, and arts, with Lewis Capaldi headlining the final night.

angles.name: Festival Wrap-up
angles.copy: That's a wrap on Latitude Festival 2026! What an incredible weekend in Suffolk, with Lewis Capaldi bringing it home tonight. Who was your must-see act?

angles.name: Suffolk Local Angle
angles.copy: Henham Park has been alive with Latitude magic! The festival finishes today, leaving us with some unforgettable memories. What was your favourite Latitude moment?
